input.summary:
Flat 2W front room is furnished in parts/room-11.mjs: a window seat under the oriel as the focal piece, a study desk and chair on the east wall, a sideboard with pots on the west wall, a table and chair, and a wool pouffe.
Walk check is OK (55 of 56 floor cells reachable; the one unreached cell is the air above a lamp, not floor). Light is min 9 with no dark or dim cells, lit by two floor lanterns and two table/desk lamps.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt with this part (21 blocks placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines); structural check shows no floating or unsupported blocks from this part.
left: No rug: carpets are not in palette.json, so the only rug-like piece is a yellow_wool pouffe block; a carpet needs a palette addition.
No barrels, bookshelves or decorated pots: not in palette.json, so shelving is a dark_oak_planks sideboard with flower_pots.
Lamps stand on the floor and on desk/table tops, not hanging: the ceiling block at y 23 is outside this room's box, so hanging lanterns were unsupported.
plan.md has no checkbox list and elements.md has no item for this room's furnishing, so nothing was ticked; the 'Light: all rooms >= 8' item spans every room and is not ticked either.
Render checked once: room.png reads as a sitting room (window seat, desk, sideboard, table, pouffe) with the lamps in place.

waste.what: Worked out each chair and seat facing by hand (a stair's facing is its back side, so the sitting direction is opposite) and typed the grid rows as strings, then fixed the row indices by hand after an off-by-one (z 16 vs z 17).
waste.cost: about 3 retries of the layer strings; roughly 25 cells of coordinate bookkeeping
waste.tool: a layers() helper that takes sit direction ('sits facing south') and derives stairs facing and half, or mcd plan printing row labels inside each layer string.

waste.what: Placed hanging lanterns, then found by check that the cell above was outside the box, so I had to rewrite three lamps as floor lanterns after a full build and check cycle.
waste.cost: one rebuild and one structure check (~2 minutes)
waste.tool: mcd room should flag a hanging lantern whose ceiling cell lies outside the part's box or is air, and suggest a standing spot instead.

waste.what: Checked the light map and walk verdict by reading the printed grids, not by a script that lists which cells remain dim after each change.
waste.cost: 2 read passes of the light grid
waste.tool: mcd room --json with a machine-readable dim list would let a lamp placement be checked without reading the grid.

companions.task: Carpets and cushions for the sitting room: a real rug and wool seat cushions, if the palette allowed carpets; this part only had yellow_wool to stand in.
A proper bookcase or open shelf against the sideboard wall with books and pots, which needs barrels or bookshelves in the palette; I could only make a plain sideboard.
